text:
THE NAZI WAR IS
OVER, BUT THE STRUGGLE
FOR A FOURTH REICH BEGINS
LONE MAN KNOWS THE WERE-
WOLF SECRET AND HE BRINGS
A VITAL MESSAGE TO SEÑORITA
RIO YET THE WEREWOLF
HAS MANY EYES AND EVEN
NOW, AS RIO WANDERS DOWN
A DARKENED STREET IN
NATAL...

IT'S A DARK STREET, BUT
I'VE GOT TO MAKE WITH
THE SHORT CUT... SAM
WILL MURDER ME IF I'M
LATE FOR THE ACT HE
BILLED ME IN AT THE
METROPOLE!
SO SHE COMES! ITS IS SEÑORITA RIO_I MUST NOT FAIL!
